source.author: cic
source.text: non enim Charybdim tam infestam neque Scyllam nautis quam istum in eodem freto fuisse arbitror; hoc etiam iste infestior, quod multo se pluribus et immanioribus canibus succinxerat, Cyclops alter multo importunior; hic enim totam insulam obsidebat, ille Aetnam solam et eam Siciliae partem tenuisse dicitur.
source.text_original: non enim Charybdim tam infestam neque Scyllam nautis quam istum in eodem freto fuisse arbitror; hoc etiam iste infestior, quod multo se pluribus et immanioribus canibus succinxerat, Cyclops alter multo importunior; hic enim totam insulam obsidebat, ille Aetnam solam et eam Siciliae partem tenuisse dicitur.
source.text_english: For I do not think Charybdis was so dangerous, nor Scylla to sailors, as that man was in the same strait; this man was even more dangerous because he had girded himself with far more and more savage dogs, a second Cyclops, much more troublesome; for the one was besieging the whole island, while the other is said to have held only Aetna and that part of Sicily.

reuse.author: hier
reuse.text: hanc feram et Charybdim Scyllamque succinctam multis canibus fugiens barbaros matrona sustinuit, quae nec naufragiis parceret nec captiuitatibus flecteretur.
reuse.text_original: hanc feram et Charybdim Scyllamque succinctam multis canibus fugiens barbaros matrona sustinuit, quae nec naufragiis parceret nec captiuitatibus flecteretur.
reuse.text_english: A barbarian matron, fleeing this wild beast and this Charybdis and Scylla girt with many dogs, endured it; she who would spare neither shipwrecks nor be bent by captivities.
